collections.name: Brain · deep structures
collections.description: Expose the thalamus, basal nuclei, fornix, commissures, choroid plexus and sectioned brainstem by removing the cerebral hemispheres and dural folds.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

steps.name: Deep structures
steps.description: The cerebral hemispheres and dural folds are hidden.

steps.name: Basal nuclei and thalamus
steps.description: Isolate the recovered basal nuclei, amygdala and thalamus meshes.

steps.name: Fornix and commissures
steps.description: Inspect corpus callosum, fornix and source-modeled commissures.

steps.name: Ventricles and choroid plexus
steps.description: Relate the ventricular surfaces to the fornix and choroid plexus.

collections.name: Brain · ventricular system
collections.description: Study the recovered ventricular surfaces with the fornix and choroid plexus. Some ventricular components share a combined mesh.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

collections.name: Brain · medial view
collections.description: A hemisphere with exposed deep structures for medial relationships. Hide individual structures or use the section plane to inspect the interior.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

collections.name: Circle of Willis
collections.description: Examine the source-labeled arterial circle against the sectioned brainstem and optic tract.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

collections.name: Heart · chambers and valves
collections.description: Open atrial and ventricular sections with their recovered internal surfaces, valves, coronary vessels and conduction pathways.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

steps.name: Open chambers
steps.description: Sectioned atria and ventricles expose the internal surfaces and atrioventricular valves.

steps.name: Atrioventricular valves
steps.description: Isolate the tricuspid and mitral valve meshes.

steps.name: Conduction pathways
steps.description: Follow the recovered conduction meshes within the chamber sections.

steps.name: Coronary relationships
steps.description: Restore coronary vessels and the full recovered open-heart scene.

collections.name: Heart · conduction pathways
collections.description: Follow the source-modeled sinoatrial node, internodal tracts, atrioventricular node, His bundle and bundle branches within the sectioned chambers.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

collections.name: Kidney · pelvis and medulla
collections.description: Remove the outer kidney surface and renal-sinus fat to expose the renal pelvis, medullary pyramids, papilla and source nephron model.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

steps.name: Pelvis and medulla
steps.description: The outer kidney surface and renal-sinus fat are removed.

steps.name: Medulla and papilla
steps.description: Inspect full and sliced medullary pyramids with the papilla.

steps.name: Pelvis and vessels
steps.description: Show the collecting pelvis alongside the recovered renal artery and vein.

steps.name: Nephron representation
steps.description: Isolate the source nephron teaching model; no unseen microscopic structures are invented.

collections.name: Kidney · nephron
collections.description: Isolate the nephron surface present in the source atlas. This is a modeled teaching representation, not a complete microscopic dataset.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

collections.name: Ear · middle and inner anatomy
collections.description: Inspect the tympanic membrane, ossicles, cochlea and vestibule, semicircular canals and vestibulocochlear branches without the skull shell.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

steps.name: Ossicular chain
steps.description: View the tympanic membrane, malleus, incus and stapes.

steps.name: Inner ear
steps.description: Inspect the source cochlea and vestibule with semicircular canals.

steps.name: Vestibulocochlear branches
steps.description: Relate the modeled vestibular and cochlear nerve branches to the inner ear.

collections.name: Eye · retina and iris
collections.description: Remove the outer eyeball to expose the recovered iris, pupil, retina and optic-nerve surfaces. The source has no separately labeled lens mesh.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

steps.name: Retina and iris
steps.description: The outer eyeball shell is removed.

steps.name: Retina and optic nerve
steps.description: Inspect the recovered retinal surface and optic nerve.

steps.name: Iris and pupil
steps.description: Isolate the iris and pupil meshes.

collections.name: Digestive · pancreatic ducts
collections.description: Expose the pancreatic ducts beside the duodenum and gallbladder; the pancreatic parenchyma is deliberately removed.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

collections.name: Respiratory · larynx and airways
collections.description: Inspect the source laryngeal cartilages, ligaments and muscles with the trachea and bronchial tree.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

collections.name: Lungs · segmental bronchi
collections.description: View twenty source-labeled segmental bronchial branches with the two outer lung shells removed. These are airway meshes, not solid segment volumes.

sourceEvidence.selection: Exact recovered sourceCodes; outer shells deliberately excluded

specimenOnlyEvidence.reason: Independent kidney-section specimen, absent from full-body and every other recovered native anatomy scene. Preserve access through dissection presets and search.

limitations: Native camera distance, orientation and runtime visibility changes have not been reproduced. Source scene membership is statically verified; web cameras fit canonical bounds.
Anatomical shells and internal surfaces are selectable source meshes. Combined meshes cannot be separated into structures absent from the source.
Curated inner-organ views rearrange visibility only; clinical review remains pending.
